title: Secret of the Sacred Symbols
tagline: Four sacred symbols. One night. Five minutes.

mission.heading: The Sealed Wing
paras: The curator of the Musée Valmont has vanished. His last message sends you, a symbologist and a codebreaker, into the sealed wing after dark.

Once every hundred years the night-lock opens the old vault, and only for five minutes. The Brotherhood of the Open Eye hid its secret behind four sacred symbols: the Rose, the Chalice, the Key and the Eye.
Follow the Maestro's trail through four rooms before the lock closes again.

tutorial.text: Drag to look around. Glowing things can be tapped.
Pick up items and read clues. Open the Maestro's Notebook to see them.
Every room has a puzzle. Close it any time with the X. Wrong answers cost Insight.
Your Insight is your score. You have 3 hints for the whole game, each costs 25 Insight. Watch the clock: five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The night-lock has opened. A hundred years of dust, and five minutes to read it.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Five minutes. I have waited longer for coffee. Let us find the curator.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Look around again. Something glints in the candlelight.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: A hand mirror. Odd thing to leave beside a visitor book.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Mirror-writing! The Maestro hid his words from anyone who only looks once.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The Moonlit Gallery. The curator's note was left on the table.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: The woman and the flame. Of course. Eyes that watch, and a light that burns.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: A hidden door behind her portrait. The Maestro loved to make us look twice.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Read the red scrawl in a mirror, then find the portrait where the eyes meet the flame.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Look at where each person is looking, not at what they hold.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Eyes on the flame. Only one painting does that.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The Hidden Studio. This is where the Maestro worked.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Lumen. It clicks open like a clock that has waited a century.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: A brass key inside. And the Maestro's creed: guard the secret, and share it wisely.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The sketch hides a word. The notebook says the cryptex answers to the word for light.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: The wheels refuse. Check the letters again.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Five wheels, five letters. The sketch scrambled them, we just have to unscramble.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The Chapter Room. Four figures, four symbols, and somebody has shuffled them.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Rose, Eye, Key, Chalice. Now the fresco makes sense.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The brotherhood's true order. The vault floor will follow it.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Use the four plaques. The Chalice sits at an end, so start there.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Not quite. Check the plaques again, one by one.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The Eye is never at an end. That helps.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The Vault. The floor is a puzzle, and the casket waits beyond it.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: The tiles sink into place. The casket is unlocked.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Now the real question. What do we do with a secret this old?

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Row one follows the fresco. Each symbol appears once in every row and column.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: No. The Maestro did not teach us that.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: Remember his creed from the studio.

dialogue.speaker: hero1
dialogue.text: The map shows a second vault. The Maestro wanted us to keep going.

dialogue.speaker: hero2
dialogue.text: Of course he did. We have only one lock's worth of luck. Let us call it a night.

mirror.name: Hand Mirror
mirror.text: A small brass hand mirror. It was left on the table beside the visitor book.

brasskey.name: Brass Key
brasskey.text: A heavy brass key with an open eye engraved in its bow. It opens the Chapter Room.

truths: The Maestro wrote in mirror-script. A hidden message needs the right way of looking.
Lumen, the old word for light, opens what the Brotherhood sealed.
The Brotherhood's order, left to right: Rose, Eye, Key, Chalice.
A secret is guarded and shared wisely, never hoarded.

r1.help: Which painting does the message point to? Tap one, then confirm.

options.label: The Lute Player
options.text: A young man tunes his lute, eyes on the strings.

options.label: Girl with a Lantern
options.text: A girl holds a lantern and stares out at the viewer.

options.label: Lady and the Flame
options.text: A woman gazes at a candle flame.

options.label: The Sleeping Scholar
options.text: A scholar dozes over his book, eyes closed.

wrong.0: His eyes are on the lute, and there is no flame.
wrong.1: There is a flame, but her eyes meet yours, not the flame.
wrong.3: His eyes are closed. He cannot watch anything.

r2.help: Tap a wheel to turn it. Set the word for light, then confirm.

r3.help: Tap the symbols in order, left to right across the fresco.
r3.wrongText: That is not the order the plaques describe.

r4a.help: Tap an empty tile to cycle its symbol. Every symbol appears once in each row and column.

r4b.help: The casket is open. What will you do with the secret?

options.label: Seal the vault and forget it
Guard it and share it wisely
Sell it to the highest bidder

wrong.0: A secret kept by one is a tomb, the Maestro wrote.
wrong.1: Forgotten, it helps nobody. Remember his creed.
wrong.3: The Maestro would never trade it for gold.

rooms.name: Moonlit Gallery
rooms.objective: Read the curator's note, then decode the red scrawl on the glass.
rooms.objectiveReady: The message names a painting. Choose it.

reward.toast: A hidden door opens behind the portrait.

hotspots.label: Visitor Book
hotspots.title: The Curator's Note
hotspots.text: "To whoever follows me: read me as the Maestro wrote. His hand ran backwards, and so does his warning. The glass panel will speak to you, if you have the right way of looking."

hotspots.label: The Red Scrawl
hotspots.title: The Message, Decoded
hotspots.text: Held to the mirror, the red scrawl reads: "Seek the portrait where the watcher's eyes meet the flame."

rooms.name: Hidden Studio
rooms.objective: Study the lantern sketch and the notebook page, then open the cryptex.
rooms.objectiveReady: You know the word. Set the cryptex.

hotspots.label: Lantern Sketch
hotspots.title: Lantern Sketch

hotspots.secret: Lumen, the old word for light

hotspots.label: Drafting Table
hotspots.title: The Maestro's Page
hotspots.text: "My cryptex answers to the word for light, in the old tongue. Remember my creed: a secret kept by one is a tomb; a secret shared by all is a rumour. Guard it, and share it wisely."

rooms.name: Chapter Room
rooms.objective: Read the fresco and the four plaques below it.
rooms.objectiveReady: Put the four symbols in order.

hotspots.label: Fresco
hotspots.title: The Fresco
views: Four hooded figures sit side by side, each holding a sacred symbol. But a forger has shuffled them: this is not the order of the Brotherhood.
Four plaques below the fresco still carry the Brotherhood's own words. Read them all.
hotspots.secret: Left to right, as seated at the Maestro's table.

hotspots.label: Plaque
hotspots.title: Plaque of the Rose
hotspots.text: The Rose sits left of the Chalice.

hotspots.label: Plaque
hotspots.title: Plaque of the Chalice
hotspots.text: The Chalice sits at an end.

hotspots.label: Plaque
hotspots.title: Plaque of the Key
hotspots.text: The Eye sits directly left of the Key.

hotspots.label: Plaque
hotspots.title: Plaque of the Eye
hotspots.text: The Eye is not at either end.

rooms.name: Vault
rooms.objective: Read the banners, then solve the engraved floor.
rooms.objectiveReady: The floor is solved. Open the casket.

hotspots.label: Rose Banner
hotspots.title: Floor Clue I
hotspots.text: Row one of the floor must follow the fresco's order. The Brotherhood carved it first, so the rest can be known.

hotspots.label: Chalice Banner
hotspots.title: Floor Clue II
hotspots.text: No symbol may stand twice in the same row or the same column. The Maestro's oldest rule.

hotspots.label: Key Banner
hotspots.title: Floor Clue III
hotspots.text: Start where a row or column has only one empty tile. Each solved tile makes the next one easier.

cinematic: The casket opens without a sound. Inside lies no gold, only a map on old parchment.
At the bottom, in the Maestro's own hand: "The first vault is only the door. The second holds what the Brotherhood truly guarded."

win.title: The Secret Is Safe
win.text: You solved the four symbols and chose wisely. Maestro Lorenzo Vantelli's map points to a second vault, and the story is not over.

timeup.title: The Lock Closes
timeup.text: The night-lock sealed the vault again. The Brotherhood's secret waits another hundred years.
